name: Embodied Navigation Benchmark
description: Large multimodal models (LMMs) show strong visual-linguistic reasoning but their capacity for spatial decision-making and action remains unclear. In this work, we investigate whether LMMs can achieve embodied spatial action like human through a challenging scenario: goal-oriented navigation in urban 3D spaces. We first spend over 500 hours constructing a dataset comprising 5,037 high-quality goal-oriented navigation samples, with an emphasis on 3D vertical actions and rich urban semantic information.
